articles.title: Biosimilar Interchangeability and PBM Formulary Strategy
articles.summary: This article discusses the evolving landscape of biosimilar interchangeability and its direct impact on PBM formulary design. For self-funded employers, shifting formulary strategies regarding biosimilars represent a major opportunity to lower specialty drug spend. Plan sponsors must closely monitor how PBMs manage interchangeability to capture potential cost savings.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Mon, 26 Oct 2026 14:52:55 GMT

articles.title: Hospitals Lose Bid to Block Drug Makers in 340B Lawsuit
articles.summary: A federal court ruling allows pharmaceutical manufacturers to intervene in an ongoing 340B drug pricing lawsuit involving hospitals. This legal battle impacts the broader 340B ecosystem, which heavily influences specialty drug costs and pricing dynamics for self-funded employer health plans.

articles.title: KFF Finds Continued Cost Increases for Employer-Sponsored Health Insurance
articles.summary: The annual KFF report reveals that premiums and out-of-pocket costs for job-based health insurance continue to rise, placing a heavier financial burden on workers. This trend underscores the mounting pressure on self-funded employers to find effective cost-containment strategies, particularly around pharmacy and specialty drug spend.

articles.title: Worker Family Health Premiums Surge 9% Amid Rising Benefit Costs
articles.summary: Employee contributions for family health coverage have jumped 9%, putting additional financial strain on workers and highlighting the escalating cost of employer-sponsored health plans. For self-funded employers, this trend underscores the urgent need to adopt aggressive cost-containment strategies, particularly within pharmacy benefits, to manage soaring health plan expenditures.

articles.title: House Lawmaker Probes PBMs Over 'Punitive' Independent Pharmacy Audits
articles.summary: A member of the House has launched an investigation into major pharmacy benefit managers regarding aggressive audit practices targeting independent pharmacies. This congressional inquiry intensifies regulatory scrutiny on PBM business operations and contract enforcement. The probe highlights ongoing federal pressure on PBM transparency and business practices that impact the broader pharmacy supply chain.

articles.title: Mark Cuban Warns CEOs of Fiduciary Liability for Suboptimal Employee Health Benefits
articles.summary: Entrepreneur Mark Cuban is warning corporate executives that self-funded employers face direct legal and fiduciary liability under ERISA if their health benefit plans fail to act in the best financial interest of employees. This highlights the growing legal pressure on plan sponsors to scrutinize PBM arrangements, hidden fees, and high drug costs to meet fiduciary duties.

articles.title: House Launches Congressional Probe Into Major PBMs
articles.summary: The House of Representatives has initiated a formal investigation into the three largest pharmacy benefit managers—Optum Rx, Express Scripts, and CVS Caremark. This probe highlights ongoing federal scrutiny over PBM business practices, pricing models, and transparency, which could lead to increased regulatory pressure and legislative changes impacting self-funded employers.
articles.source_line: Source: Modern Healthcare News; Mon, 26 Oct 2026 15:08:00 GMT

articles.title: CVS Restores Weight Loss Drug Coverage and Adds New Oral Options
articles.summary: CVS has reversed course by restoring weight loss drug coverage and incorporating new pill-based therapies into its formulary. This shift signals changing PBM strategies around obesity medications, directly impacting benefit design and cost management for self-funded employers navigating GLP-1 coverage.

articles.title: Missouri AG Targets Eli Lilly Over Drug Pricing Policy in Cease-and-Desist
articles.summary: The Missouri Attorney General has issued a cease-and-desist letter to drug manufacturer Eli Lilly regarding its pricing and distribution policies. This state-level enforcement action signals growing regulatory scrutiny on pharmaceutical pricing strategies that directly impact commercial health plans and self-funded employer drug spend.

articles.title: Job-Based Health Plan Costs Continue to Rise Sharply
articles.summary: Employer-sponsored health insurance costs are climbing significantly with little expectation of near-term relief, placing mounting financial pressure on self-funded plans. This trend underscores the urgent need for employers to adopt aggressive PBM strategies and cost-containment measures to manage escalating pharmacy and medical benefits spend.
articles.source_line: Source: Hanford Sentinel; Mon, 26 Oct 2026 19:48:14 GMT

articles.title: CVS Caremark Details Strategy for GLP-1 Cost and Access Management
articles.summary: CVS Caremark outlines its latest approach to managing the surging costs and utilization of GLP-1 medications for weight management. The strategy directly impacts self-funded employers navigating how to balance employee benefit demands with soaring specialty drug expenditures. PBM strategies in this category heavily influence employer plan design and cost containment decisions.
articles.source_line: Source: CVS Health; Mon, 26 Oct 2026 18:20:24 GMT

articles.title: UnitedHealthcare Highlights Cost Savings from Bundling Specialty and Medical Benefits
articles.summary: UnitedHealthcare claims that integrating and bundling specialty pharmacy benefits with medical coverage drives lower overall costs and improves health outcomes for employers. This strategy targets self-funded plan sponsors seeking to manage high-cost specialty drug trends through integrated benefit designs.
